[[Category:Social psychology]]
[[File:Young children playing.png|thumbnail|'''Group identity''' may be a helpful conceptual model to understand why even children may practice [[sexual discrimination]].]]
'''Group identity''' describes an individual's perception of belonging/exclusion relative to different [[social group]]s.

Groups one identify with are called '''in-groups'''.

Groups perceived fundamentally different from one's '''in-groups''' are called '''out-groups'''.
